label: Bible Study
prompt: Let us search and try our _____, and turn again to the LORD.
verse: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
note: In the middle of the lament, a call to self-examination — then turning back home.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David _____ himself in the LORD his God.
verse: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.
note: David's worst day at Ziklag — his own men talking of stoning him — and he encouraged himself in the LORD.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee _____ of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
note: The KJV calls them 'tables of stone' — what most of us learned to call tablets.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in _____ into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verse: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
note: Priests entered yearly with borrowed blood; Christ entered once with his own — and it never needs repeating.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, _____, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verse: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
note: Paul's prayer list for Timothy: 'supplications, prayers, intercessions,' and thanks — for all men, kings included.
